summary: Chip stocks snapped out of Monday's bear-market slide Tuesday, lifting the Nasdaq and S&P while the Dow lagged on Apple's warning over rising memory costs. Gold and Treasuries eased as capital rotated back into tech, and investors turned to midterm election results with volatility still elevated.
tweet: Chip stocks rebounded from Monday's bear market Tuesday, lifting Nasdaq and S&P as gold and bonds eased and traders eyed midterm results.
